init.title: Ride windows and approach distance
init.description: The integration polls every minute inside these windows (or while a student is on the bus) and less often otherwise. While a student is on the bus the bus position is polled every 10 seconds. The bus counts as approaching when it is closer to the home stop than the approach distance.
